body:
PR-2779 ready (BUG-2191): 42eb7a5972 on claude/bug-2191, 0 behind main.
- Helper (signoff 1): aida_core::git_ops::NO_AUTO_MAINTENANCE (production transaction_git_config now returns it); test_git::git_command() in aida-core + aida-cli-lib (cfg(test)) and aida-cli/tests/support/test_git.rs via #[path]. No global GIT_CONFIG_* env. Arg-pinning unit test per crate.
- Ratchet (signoff 2): tests/test_git_maintenance_ratchet.py, CI gate "Test git auto-maintenance ratchet" (fast tier, so in check-ci-fast). Counts unguarded write-class git sites (commit/commit-tree/merge/am/rebase/cherry-pick/revert/pull/fetch) in test code: direct, via local fn/closure wrappers (scope-resolved, guard propagates transitively), and in shell-script strings. Per-file baseline in scripts/git-maintenance-baseline.txt may only go down; 6 self-tests.
- Migration (signoff 3): 687 -> 46 sites. 397 mechanical Command::new("git") -> helper in 182 files (test code only) plus 10 inline script guards. The only flaked file (task_1507 history fixture) was already guarded and keeps its unguarded control; the last 60 failed CI runs show no other "unable to create temporary file". The rest (mostly production helpers under test) drain via the ratchet.
- Repro (signoff 4): git 2.55.0 built from source + BUG-2118 LD_PRELOAD shim on migrated auto_bump_done_tests: guarded 5/5 pass; guard removed 1/5 fails with "unable to create temporary file". Recorded in the docs/testing note.
Gates: check-ci-fast 33/33, check-ci-compile ok after merging main, targeted tests 591 + 360 + 75 passed.
FLAG: my first push 24fd1272ea was squashed onto a moved main and reverted faf1f33a7f (v0.16.0 release) + 12d4692052 (TASK-1957). Fixed by c282e804ea without force-push; net diff vs main is only BUG-2191 (Cargo.toml still 0.16.0). Please squash-merge.
subject: PR-2779 ready (BUG-2191)
